<!-- All news items below this line -->{{Current events|year=2002|month=10|day=27|content=

;Politics and elections
* [[Leftist]] [[Luis Inácio Lula da Silva]] handily wins Brazil's presidential election.

;Sport
* The [[Los Angeles Angels of Anaheim|Anaheim Angels]] win the [[2002 World Series]] by four games to three, with a 4–1 win over the [[San Francisco Giants]] in Game 7.
* [[Emmitt Smith]] of the [[Dallas Cowboys]] passes [[Walter Payton]] as the [[National Football League|NFL]]'s leading rusher in a 17–14 loss to the [[Seattle Seahawks]].

;Television
*The [[ITV (TV network)|ITV]] London area television network [[London Weekend Television]] closes and [[Carlton Communications]] took over the channel.

;Games
*[[Rockstar Games]] Video games series [[Grand Theft Auto]], [[Grand Theft Auto: Vice City]] October 27, 2002 released came out that day.
